# Story 01 --- Repository & Developer Workflow (Story: CRM-107)

## Prerequisites

- None. This is the first implementation story in Sprint 0 and
establishes the repository baseline that later stories (CRM-104 Angular
workspace, CRM-105 ASP.NET Core modular monolith, CRM-197 Docker
Compose, CRM-203 CI quality gates) build on.

- Coordinate any change that touches root-level tooling
(e.g. `.gitignore`, `.editorconfig`) with the maintainer of the
squad-kit block; do **not** edit inside the `# Managed by
squad-kit` fence in `.gitignore` (see lines 1--5).

---

## Story Goal

Prepare the repository so a fresh clone can build, test and run Squad
CRM consistently, without prematurely implementing feature-level work.
Concretely:

1. Establish the top-level layout that will hold the Angular workspace,
the ASP.NET Core modular monolith and shared docs/tests, while
preserving `.squad/`, `.claude/`, `docs/` and `CLAUDE.md` as-is.

2. Commit editor, lint/format and Git ignore rules that apply to both
TypeScript/Angular and .NET codebases.

3. Document branch/commit conventions, local setup, migrations, tests
and common commands in `README.md` so a new contributor can reach a
running system from a clean clone.

4. Provide sample environment configuration (no real secrets) that the
later persistence/infrastructure stories will consume.

**Explicitly out of scope** (deferred to sibling Sprint 0
stories):

- Creating the Angular workspace itself (CRM-104).

- Creating .NET solution/projects or EF Core migrations (CRM-105,
CRM-106).

- Docker Compose services (CRM-197), Outbox (CRM-198), Hangfire
(CRM-199), file storage (CRM-200), observability (CRM-201), automated
test scaffolding (CRM-202), CI (CRM-203), shared API/security foundation
(CRM-204).

- Any CRM business module or UI.

Only create scaffolding files (README sections, ignore rules, sample
env, empty placeholders with `.gitkeep`) that the follow-up stories
need in order to start. Do **not** create empty Angular/.NET
projects.

## Product rules (from story)

- **Business Rule 1 --- No committed secrets.** `.env`,
`appsettings.Development.local.json`, `*.pfx`, `secrets.*` and
equivalent files must be ignored. Only `*.example` / `*.sample`
templates are committed.

- **Business Rule 2 --- Reproducible, automation-first setup.**
Every command mentioned in README must correspond to a real file/script
in the repo. Do not document commands that will only exist after later
stories; mark them as **"(added by CRM-XXX)"** if you want to
preview them.

- **Business Rule 3 --- Docs update rule.** Any future change
to setup commands or configuration requires an update to `README.md`
and, when architectural, to `docs/adr/`. Restate this rule in the
README's "Contributing" section.

### 2 --- `.editorconfig`

**Create file:** `.editorconfig` at repo root.

Contents must at minimum:

```ini

root = true

[*]

charset = utf-8

end_of_line = lf

insert_final_newline = true

trim_trailing_whitespace = true

indent_style = space

indent_size = 2

[*.{cs,csproj,sln,props,targets}]

indent_size = 4

[*.md]

trim_trailing_whitespace = false

[Makefile]

indent_style = tab

```

Rationale: aligns with Angular (2-space) and .NET (4-space) defaults so
CRM-104 / CRM-105 do not need to fight the editor.

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **Squad-kit fence edited by accident.** If any line between
`# Managed by squad-kit --- do not edit this block` (`.gitignore`
line 1) and `# End squad-kit block` (line 5) changes, revert. New
ignore rules go strictly below line 5. Verify with `git diff
.gitignore` before commit.

- **Line endings on Windows.** `.editorconfig` sets
`end_of_line = lf`; if a contributor's editor overrides, the executor
must add a `.gitattributes` with `* text=auto eol=lf` --- do this
preventively as part of task 2.

- **Empty directories dropped by Git.** Every scaffolding
directory must contain either a `.gitkeep` or a placeholder
`README.md`; verify with `git status --porcelain` after `git add`.

- **`env/backend.env` accidentally committed.** The rule
`.env.*` with `!*.env.example` re-include must be tested by
running `git check-ignore -v env/backend.env` (expected: ignored) and
`git check-ignore -v env/backend.env.example` (expected: not ignored).

- **README documents non-existent commands.** Every command in
the "Common commands" table must resolve to a file in the repo after
this story. If a command belongs to CRM-104/105/197/203, it must be
visibly labelled with that story id, not presented as usable today.

- **Contributors on case-insensitive filesystems (macOS
default).** Do not introduce two paths that differ only by case
(e.g. `Src/` and `src/`). Use lowercase throughout.

- **Unicode / RTL in commit messages.** The commit convention
doc must state that titles are ASCII English (Conventional Commits) even
though the product supports Arabic; localized content lives in the body
if needed.

- **Concurrent Sprint 0 branches.** CRM-104, CRM-105 and
CRM-197 will branch off this story's merge commit. Do not pre-create
their directory structures beyond `.gitkeep` placeholders ---
otherwise their PRs will conflict.

## Test Plan

There is no runtime code in this story; verification is structural.

1. **Repository shape check (manual).** After merge, from a
fresh `git clone` a reviewer runs `ls src/ tests/ scripts/ env/` and
confirms every directory exists with its `.gitkeep` or placeholder
`README.md`.

2. **Ignore rules smoke test (manual, reproducible).** From
repo root run:

- `git check-ignore -v env/backend.env` → must print a matching rule
from `.gitignore`.

- `git check-ignore -v env/backend.env.example` → must print nothing
(exit 1).

- `git check-ignore -v node_modules/foo` → must match.

- `git check-ignore -v src/backend/bin/Debug/x.dll` → must match.

3. **`.editorconfig` load test.** Open `README.md` and a
hypothetical `test.cs` (create locally, do not commit) in an
EditorConfig-aware editor; confirm indent size 2 vs 4 respectively.

4. **README link check.** Every relative link in `README.md`
and `docs/development/branching-and-commits.md` resolves (`grep -oE
'\]\([^)]+\)' README.md` and verify each file exists).

5. **No accidental deletion of pre-existing docs.** `git diff
--name-status main...HEAD` shows only additions and the intended
`.gitignore` / `README.md` modifications; no file under
`docs/adr/`, `docs/architecture/`, `docs/development/`,
`.claude/` or `.squad/` outside this plan is changed.

6. **Fresh-clone rehearsal.** In a scratch directory: `git
clone <repo> squadcrm-fresh && cd squadcrm-fresh && cp
env/backend.env.example env/backend.env && cp env/frontend.env.example
env/frontend.env` --- must complete without error and produce two
git-ignored env files.

Automated test scaffolding (unit / integration frameworks) is
deliberately deferred to CRM-202.

## Migration / Rollback

- **Migration:** none --- no schema, no runtime code.

- **Rollback:** if the merge causes downstream stories
(CRM-104/105/197) to conflict, revert the PR as a whole. Because this
story only adds files and appends to `.gitignore` / `README.md`
outside protected regions, revert is a clean `git revert
<merge-sha>` with no data implications.

- **Half-applied risk:** the only risk is a partial merge where
`env/*.env.example` exists but `.gitignore` was not updated --- a
contributor could then commit `env/backend.env`. Reviewer must confirm
the `.gitignore` append landed in the same commit/PR as the `env/`
templates.

## Verification Steps

1. **Structure builds:** from repo root run `git ls-files src
tests scripts env` and confirm the placeholders listed in task 1 are
tracked.

2. **Ignore rules:** run the four `git check-ignore -v ...`
commands listed in Test Plan step 2.

3. **Editor rules:** confirm `.editorconfig` and
`.gitattributes` (if added per Edge Cases) exist at repo root with
`ls -a .editorconfig .gitattributes`.

4. **Docs render:** open `README.md` in a Markdown previewer
and confirm all sections in task 6 are present and all links resolve.

5. **Regression --- untouched areas:** `git diff main -- docs/
CLAUDE.md .claude/ .squad/config.yaml` must be empty (no unintended
edits).

6. **Fresh-clone rehearsal:** perform Test Plan step 6
end-to-end.

7. **Definition of Done cross-check:** review
`docs/development/definition-of-done.md` line-by-line; items not
applicable (server-side auth, migrations, telemetry, RTL) are marked N/A
in the PR description with justification "no runtime code in CRM-107".
